question: Recurrent pregnancy loss (RPL) is defined as the loss of two or more consecutive pregnancies before 20 weeks of gestation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is FALSE. The standard definition of RPL is THREE or more consecutive pregnancy losses before 20 weeks. Two losses prompt counselling but the formal diagnosis typically requires three consecutive events.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is FALSE. The classical definition is THREE or more consecutive losses before 20 weeks. Some organisations (e.g., ESHRE 2017) have proposed ≥2 losses as a threshold to begin investigation, but the standard definition requires ≥3.
